headline: Equinix (EQIX) Appoints Chris Audie And Bruce Owen To Key Leadership Roles
summary: Equinix (NasdaqGS:EQIX) has updated its executive team with two senior appointments. Chris Audie has been named Chief Product Officer. Bruce Owen has been appointed Executive Vice President, Global Markets. The company expects these leadership moves to support product development and expansion across global markets.
